status: fixed_before_new_probe_results; post-hoc development on existing seed42 caches
bn_scope: Existing old-policy checkpoints; corrected BN confirmation remains gated
validation_usage: Already inspected development description only; never fit, select or decide the D_rel resource gate

folds.assignment: sort SHA256(namespace|image_id), round-robin; inner folds use only outer training images with namespace suffix inner

mc_calibrator.formula: correctness logit = a * standardized(logit_mc) + b; a >= 1e-6
mc_calibrator.optimizer: deterministic FP64 damped Newton with line search
mc_calibrator.ranking_note: strictly monotone in logit_mc within each fold/refit; pooled OOF calibrators differ by fold; raw float32 MC ties may differ

temperature_provenance: fixed from previous D_rel-only selection at all stages; no new search and no claim of untouched development data

correction.linear: one centered standardized basis per input, no intercept
correction.additive: linear plus centered/scaled positive hinges at training-weighted quantiles; duplicate and zero-variance columns removed
correction.fit_seed_scope: minibatch sequence only; same batches across feature/form comparisons; 500 is a prefix of 2000
correction.loss: natural-correctness BCE with inverse pixel sampling weights; no class balancing
correction.selection: pooled inner image-OOF weighted NLL, separately for each feature set/budget/fit seed; zero wins improvements <=1e-6, then linear before additive

strata.boundary: existing cached distance-3 GT boundary, diagnosis only
strata.outputs: MC x prototype margin, predicted class x boundary, and full four-way support; keep unsupported and empty cells

distributions.correlation: IPW Pearson and weighted midrank Spearman for e versus top2; report all/conflict/high-MC/high-MC-conflict separately
distributions.features: streamed normalized feature mean/variance by role and predicted class, no validation-dependent normalization for fitting

statistics.limitation: paired images conditional on fitted cross-validation predictions; folds/stages/sampler seeds are not independent teacher repetitions; no training-population inference

gate.eligible_for_one_bn_confirmation_teacher: adequate support; all four late primary lower bounds >0; late e-minus-MC lower95 >0; each primary contrast positive in >=2/3 stages; all four late point contrasts positive under both budgets and both sampler seeds; no clear all-pixel AP harm (upper95<0) for e-minus-MC or controls_e-minus-controls in any stage
gate.failure: stop expansion of current residual-weighted evidence formula; preserve all results; no automatic signed/multi-prototype/network search
gate.scope: eligibility for one repaired seed42 teacher only, not P2 or independent-seed/data generalization
